Direct straight-isochrone projection of the stated cubic controller gives exactly minus the source's Eq. (55), and symbolic verification reduces the residual to zero. With controller strength epsilon^2, mixed corrections first enter at order epsilon^3.

No source-specific correction or SCOPE overlap was found. General exact interaction design is known and explicitly excluded from novelty; the complete proof body of Namura–Muolo–Nakao (2026) was not fully inspected and remains a material residual risk for broader formulations.
